title: Two factorizations of the ringed-topos external product comparison
statement:
Let $X,Y,W$ be topoi presented by sites small in the universe of [def-weil-size-convention], with sheaves of commutative rings. Let $q:X\to Y$ and $a,b:W\to X$ be morphisms of ringed topoi with a specified commutation isomorphism $qa\cong qb$. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], canonical derived adjunctions, pullback tensor comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] and direct-image composition comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Write $L=Lq^*$, $R=Rq_*$, $A=La^*$, $B=Lb^*$, $S=Ra_*$ and $U=Rb_*$. Identify $AL\cong BL$ and $RS\cong RU$ by these comparisons. Define $\beta_M:LRM\to UAM$ as the mate of $BL\cong AL$, and $\bar\beta_N:LRN\to SBN$ as the mate of its inverse [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. For a ringed-topos morphism $f$ let $\pi_f: Rf_*E\otimes^L Q\to Rf_*(E\otimes^L Lf^*Q)$ be the adjunct of counit tensor identity, as in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence]; tensor symmetry is used to put factors in the displayed order.

For every $M,N\in D(X)$ the two composites
$$\begin{aligned}
RM\otimes^L RN&\xrightarrow{\pi_q}R(LRM\otimes^L N)\xrightarrow{R(\beta_M\otimes1)}R(UAM\otimes^L N)\xrightarrow{R\pi_b}RU(AM\otimes^L BN),\\
RM\otimes^L RN&\xrightarrow{\pi_q}R(M\otimes^L LRN)\xrightarrow{R(1\otimes\bar\beta_N)}R(M\otimes^L SBN)\xrightarrow{R\pi_a}RS(AM\otimes^L BN)
\end{aligned}$$
are equal under $RU\cong RS$. Their common transpose under the composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] is
$$ (qa)^*(RM\otimes^L RN)\cong ALRM\otimes^L BLRN\xrightarrow{A(v_M)\otimes B(v_N)}AM\otimes^L BN,$$
where $v:LR\to1$ is the original derived-adjunction counit. No cartesianness, properness, boundedness or invertibility of $\beta,\bar\beta,\pi$ is assumed.

proof.text: Establish the tensor identity for the specified RingedTensorSquare. Form the two natural transformations whose components are theta followed by the A-path tensor map and the B-path tensor map followed by tensor(theta,theta). Restriction to pairs of flat K-flat homotopy complexes is injective by lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent. On representatives they agree by lem-weil-pbc-ringed-square-tensor-compatibility, using the defining representative equation of derivedComparison. Transport along quotientCompQhIso and naturality extends equality to all derived objects. This uses the specified comparison directly and requires no additional right-derived witnesses.

proof.text: Apply mateEquiv_counit to the comparison and its inverse. These give B(beta_M);w_AM = theta_RM;A(v_M) and A(bar-beta_N);s_BN = theta_RN inverse;B(v_N), respectively. Neither mate is inverted.

proof.text: Expand the hom bijection of the composite adjunction. Naturality of the hom bijection transposes the q-projection to its tensor-comparison/counit definition and then the b-projection to its own definition. Naturality of the b tensor comparison moves the exchange and q-counit through it. Tensor bifunctoriality combines them. The first transpose is d_B followed by tensor(theta_RM;A(v_M),B(v_N)), using the first mate equation.

proof.text: Perform the same calculation with the opposite factor order for the second route. Its transpose is d_A followed by tensor(A(v_M),theta_RN inverse;B(v_N)), using the second mate equation. This is definitionally commonTranspose and proves the second conjunct.

proof.text: Mathlib conjugateEquiv_counit for the inverse comparison and naturality of theta inverse show that transposing first followed by directComparison inverse equals theta_T inverse followed by the first transpose. This is the specific adjunction-compatible directComparison defined in the module, so no independent normalization witnesses are needed.

source.place: Tags 07A7 (remark-base-change), 0B56 (equation-projection-formula-map), 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); two-counit expansion of the blueprint First identity

proof.text: Compare the transported first transpose with commonTranspose. Precompose with theta_T and cancel theta_T;theta_T inverse. The tensor identity of step 1 replaces theta_T;d_A by d_B;tensor(theta_RM,theta_RN). Tensor functoriality and cancellation on the second factor give equality with d_B;tensor(theta_RM;A(v_M),B(v_N)). Injectivity of the composite adjunction hom bijection proves the first conjunct. The unit First identity is preserved.
